title: Weekly email digest notification setting
purpose: Document the requested behavior for a member-controlled weekly email digest setting, including its persistence and its relationship to account-security messages.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on, then the weekly digest setting shows as on.
Given a member has switched weekly email digests on, when a weekly digest cycle occurs, then the member receives the weekly email digest.
Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests off, then the weekly digest setting shows as off.
Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when a weekly digest cycle occurs, then the member does not receive the weekly email digest.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly digest preference to remain in effect across sign-out and sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests on and then signs out, when the member signs in again, then weekly email digests are still on.
Given a member has switched weekly email digests off and then signs out, when the member signs in again, then weekly email digests are still off.

stories.text: As a member, I want switching weekly digests off to leave account-security messages enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when an account-security message is generated, then that account-security message is still sent to the member.

stories.text: As a new member, I want my account to start with weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a newly created member account, when the member views notification settings before making any change, then weekly email digests show as off.
Given a newly created member account that has not switched weekly email digests on, when a weekly digest cycle occurs, then the member does not receive the weekly email digest.

edge_cases.text: Verify that switching weekly email digests off does not disable account-security messages.
Verify that the weekly digest preference survives sign-out and sign-in in both the on and off states.

dependencies.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown.

risks.text: If account-security messages are tied to the same switch as weekly digests, switching weekly digests off could suppress account-security messages, which would contradict the supplied exception.

success_metrics.text: Proposed verification: after signing in and out, the stored weekly digest setting matches the member's most recent on or off selection.
Proposed verification: account-security messages are still delivered for a member whose weekly email digests are off.

open_questions: What storage and synchronization mechanism should hold the setting so that it persists after sign-out and sign-in?
What exactly qualifies as an account-security message for the purposes of the exception, and is it governed by the same notification settings screen?
Which notification settings surface shows the weekly digest switch, and does any other setting interact with it?
Who owns this feature and what is its delivery date?
